answer_3.quote: We report the blind pairwise comparison of each task selection methods with Random Sampling on the 252 user-oriented test set. We follow the evaluation in Vicuna to report GPT-4, Chat-GPT (GPT‑3.5) and Human evaluation scores.

answer_4.quote: We only conduct the human evaluation to compare our proposed Prompt Uncertainty to Random Sampling method due to high evaluation cost ($600 US Dollars).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators performed pairwise comparisons between model outputs to determine which was preferred.
